sentences.en: A Pap test can help detect cervical cancer early on.
sentences.zh: 宫颈癌筛查有助于早期发现癌症。

sentences.en: The patient injured his upper cervical posterior spinal artery by sneezing.
sentences.zh: 患者打喷嚏时伤到了颈部后部的血管。

sentences.en: The HPV vaccine can help prevent cervical cancer.
sentences.zh: HPV疫苗可以帮助预防宫颈癌。
